info.title: VeriWorkly API
info.description:
The official API reference for VeriWorkly.

### Authentication Methods

VeriWorkly supports two authentication methods:

#### 1. API Key Authentication (recommended for scripts and integrations)
For programmatic access, send your key either way — both are accepted:

- `X-API-Key: vw_...`
- `Authorization: Bearer vw_...`

A key is **required** for any request that does not originate from a whitelisted VeriWorkly
origin, including requests made from these documentation pages.

- **Format**: `vw_` followed by 64 hexadecimal characters.
- **Rate limit**: 20 requests per 15 minutes per key by default, configurable per key at
  creation. Responses carry `X-RateLimit-Limit`, `X-RateLimit-Remaining`, and
  `X-RateLimit-Reset`.
- **Scopes**: keys are scope-gated. A key missing a route's required scope gets `403`. Session
  callers are never scope-gated.

#### 2. Session Authentication (dashboard only)
Used internally by the VeriWorkly dashboard and resume builder, via secure HTTP-only cookies
issued by Better Auth.

- **Cookies**:
  - Local: `veriworkly-auth.session_token`
  - Production: `__Secure-veriworkly-auth.session_token`
- **Note**: sessions are only honoured for whitelisted origins. Send `credentials: 'include'`
  (fetch) or `withCredentials: true` (axios). Requests from these documentation pages **must**
  use an API key.

#### Endpoints that need neither
Only `GET /api/v1/health` and `GET /api/v1/health/ready` are fully open. Everything else —
including the endpoints labelled "public", such as public portfolios and share links — still
requires an API key or a whitelisted first-party origin, and returns `401` without one.

### Response Envelope

Every endpoint under `/api/v1` except the Better Auth routes at `/api/v1/auth/*` returns
`{ success, message, data }` on success and `{ success, message, statusCode, details? }` on
failure. Better Auth endpoints return their own payload shapes.

get.description:
Lightweight liveness probe. Confirms the API process is up and responding.

It deliberately touches **no** external dependency — no database query, no Redis command — so
that frequent uptime polling does not keep database compute awake. It therefore cannot report
on PostgreSQL or Redis, and never returns `503`. For dependency health use
`GET /api/v1/health/ready`.

This is the only truly public endpoint on the API: it requires no session, no API key, and no
first-party origin.

Deep readiness probe for deploy gates and manual diagnostics. Runs a `SELECT 1` against
PostgreSQL and a `PING` against Redis, and returns `503` if either is unreachable.

Because it wakes database compute on every call, prefer `GET /api/v1/health` for routine
uptime monitoring. Like the liveness probe, it requires no authentication.

200.description: Database and Redis are both reachable

503.description:
The database or Redis could not be reached. The response carries no diagnostic detail —
the underlying error is logged server-side only.

get.description:
Retrieves account metadata for the currently authenticated user. Requires the `user:read`
scope when called with an API key.

This returns identity metadata only — resume, cover letter, and portfolio content is never
exposed here. Results are cached for 30 minutes and refreshed on write.

put.description:
Updates the display name of the authenticated user. Requires the `user:write` scope when
called with an API key.

The email address is read-only through this API. Leading and trailing whitespace is trimmed
before validation.

name.description: Name cannot be null or empty when updating.

400.description: Validation error

put.description:
Claims the authenticated user's username. Requires the `user:write` scope when called with an
API key.

The username is the public identifier in share-link URLs (`/share/{username}/{slug}`) and, for
accounts holding `custom_subdomain`, the published-portfolio subdomain — so a user cannot
create a share link until one is set.

**A username can only be set once.** Once the account has one, this endpoint rejects any
different value with `409 Username is locked and cannot be changed`. Re-sending the value the
account already holds is a no-op and returns `200`, so the call is safe to retry.

The submitted value is **normalised before validation**: lowercased, non-`[a-z0-9_-]`
characters folded to hyphens, leading/trailing hyphens stripped, and truncated to 32
characters. `Jane.Doe` and `jane-doe` therefore claim the same username. It must survive
normalisation as 3–32 characters and must not be a reserved word (`admin`, `api`, `app`,
`docs`, and similar platform-owned names). Check with
`GET /users/{username}/availability` before committing.

A successful claim invalidates the caller's cached session so the new username is visible
immediately rather than at the end of the session-cache TTL.

username.description: Normalised server-side before the validity check runs.

400.description: The username failed validation after normalisation.

409.description: The username is taken, or this account already has one.

locked.summary: This account already has a username

value.message: Username is locked and cannot be changed

put.description:
Turns the account-level background document sync on or off. Requires the `user:write` scope
when called with an API key.

This is the account-wide switch. It does not override a document's own `keepLocalOnly` flag —
a document opted out individually stays local even with auto-sync on. Turning auto-sync off
does not delete anything already synced; it only stops new local edits from being pushed.

Defaults to `true` on a new account. A successful change invalidates the caller's cached
session.

400.description: Validation error

get.description:
Reports whether a username can be claimed. Intended to drive live feedback in a username
picker before `PUT /users/me/username` is called.

This route carries **no API-key scope gate**, unlike the rest of the Users module — but it is
still not anonymous, so it needs an API key or a whitelisted first-party origin.

The path segment is normalised the same way the update endpoint normalises it, and
`normalizedUsername` echoes back the value that would actually be stored. A `200` with
`available: false` is the normal negative answer — an unavailable name is not an error.

parameters.name: username
parameters.description: The candidate username. Normalised server-side before the lookup.

This endpoint has no user session of its own: call it with an API key holding the

Results are cached per query for `CHANGELOG_CACHE_TTL_SECONDS` (default 30 days) and busted

get.description:
Fetch aggregated issue and pull-request statistics for the configured repository, as of the
last sync. Served from the last synced snapshot, not live from GitHub — `syncedAt` tells you
how fresh it is. Cached for 12 hours.

This endpoint has no user session of its own: call it with an API key holding the
`github:read` scope, or from a whitelisted first-party origin. A request with neither is
rejected with `401`.

Fetch paginated GitHub issues and pull requests with optional filters, from the last synced
snapshot rather than live from GitHub. Ordered by most recently updated. Returns an empty
page when no sync has run yet.

Requires the `github:read` scope when called with an API key.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description:
Derived at sync time — closed items and items labelled `done` map to `done`; items
labelled `in-progress`, `in progress`, or `active` map to `in-progress`; everything else
is `todo`.

parameters.name: kind
parameters.description: `all` is equivalent to omitting the filter.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Items per page. Values above 50 are rejected with `400`.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: 1-based page index. An alternative to `offset`.

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: Alternative spelling of `limit`. Takes precedence over `limit` when both are sent.

post.description:
Manually triggers a GitHub sync. **Administrators only** — the caller's session email must
match the configured `ADMIN_EMAIL`; an API key cannot reach this route.

Incremental by default: only issues updated since the last sync are refetched. The run is
guarded by a 10-minute Redis lock, so a concurrent attempt fails with `409` rather than
double-syncing. The response is the updated sync record.

403.description: The authenticated user is not the configured administrator.

example.message: GitHub sync is already in progress

502.description: The GitHub API could not be reached, or kept returning a retryable error.

post.description:
Emails a one-time password to the given address.

Authentication is handled by **Better Auth**, mounted at `/api/v1/auth`. Its endpoints return
Better Auth's own payloads — they are **not** wrapped in the `{ success, message, data }`
envelope the rest of this API uses.

Rate limited to 3 requests per minute per IP.

type.description:
Required. Use `sign-in` for the login flow — that is what the VeriWorkly
dashboard sends.

200.description:
OTP sent. Returns `{ "success": true }` whether or not the address maps to an existing
account, so this endpoint cannot be used to enumerate registered emails.

400.description: Missing or malformed email address.

429.description: Too many OTP requests — 3 per minute per IP.

post.description:
Exchanges a valid OTP for a session. On success the session cookie is set via `Set-Cookie`
and the session token plus the user record are returned.

A user is created automatically on first sign-in. Codes expire after 5 minutes and allow 3
attempts by default. This endpoint returns Better Auth's payload, not the
`{ success, message, data }` envelope.

Rate limited to 20 requests per minute per IP — the default for `/api/v1/auth/*`. (A tighter
5/minute rule exists in configuration but targets `/email-otp/verify-otp`, a path this Better
Auth version does not expose, so it never applies.)

200.description: OTP verified. Sets the session cookie and returns the session token and user.

token.description: Session token for the authenticated session.

400.description: The OTP is invalid, expired, or the attempt limit was exceeded.

429.description: Too many requests — 20 per minute per IP.

get.description:
Returns the active session and its user, based on the request's session cookie. Returns
`null` rather than an error when no valid session cookie is present.

This endpoint returns Better Auth's payload, not the `{ success, message, data }` envelope.

200.description: The active `{ session, user }` pair, or `null` when the caller has no valid session.

post.description:
Revokes the current session and clears the session cookie. Also flushes the server-side
session cache for that cookie.

This endpoint returns Better Auth's payload, not the `{ success, message, data }` envelope.

200.description: Signed out. Clears the session cookie.

get.description:
Lists the caller's API keys, newest first.

**No form of the secret is returned here — not even a masked one.** Each entry carries only
`keyPrefix`, the first 8 characters of the key, which is enough to tell keys apart in a list.
If you lose a secret, rotate the key.

Session-authenticated only — an API key cannot be used to manage API keys.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: 1-based page index. An alternative to `offset`.

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: Alternative spelling of `limit`. Takes precedence over `limit` when both are sent.

post.description:
Generates a new API key. **The full secret is returned exactly once, in this response.** It
is stored only as an HMAC-SHA256 hash and can never be retrieved again — save it immediately.

Session-authenticated only — an API key cannot be used to mint API keys.

name.description: A descriptive name for the API key.

scopes.description:
Scopes granted to the new key. Defaults to `["user:read"]` when omitted. Any
value outside the listed set is rejected with `400`.

rateLimit.description:
Requests allowed per 15-minute window. Defaults to 20; values above 20 are
silently clamped down to 20 rather than rejected.

expiresAt.description:
ISO timestamp for expiry. Defaults to 365 days from creation when omitted — keys
are never issued without an expiry.

example.message: API key generated successfully. Please save it as it won't be shown again.

400.description: Missing name, an unsupported scope, or a malformed `rateLimit`/`expiresAt`.

post.description:
Revokes the target key and issues a replacement in one transaction. The old secret stops
working immediately.

Every field in the body is optional — send `{}` to rotate the secret while carrying over the
existing name, scopes, and rate limit. As with creation, the new secret is returned exactly
once. The response also carries `rotatedFromId`, the id of the key that was replaced.

Only an active, unrevoked key can be rotated; anything else returns `404`.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The ID of the API key to rotate.

name.description: Replacement name. Carried over from the old key when omitted or blank.

scopes.description: Scopes for the replacement key. Carried over from the old key when omitted.

rateLimit.description:
Requests allowed per 15-minute window. Carried over when omitted; values above 20
are silently clamped down to 20.

expiresAt.description:
New expiry. Carried over from the old key when omitted, falling back to 365 days
from now if the old key had none.

example.message: API key rotated successfully. Please save the new key immediately.

400.description: An unsupported scope, or a malformed `rateLimit`/`expiresAt`.

404.description: No active key with this ID belongs to the caller.

example.message: API key not found or inactive

post.description:
Immediately disables an API key without deleting its record — `isActive` becomes false and
`revokedAt` is stamped. The cached authentication record is purged at the same time, so the
secret stops working right away rather than after the cache expires.

A revoked key cannot be reactivated; rotate or create a new one instead. `data` is `null` on
success.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The ID of the API key to revoke.

404.description: No key with this ID belongs to the caller.

get.description:
Returns the full metadata record for one of the caller's keys — name, scopes, rate limit,
expiry, revocation state, and last-used timestamp.

**The secret is not returned**, and cannot be: only an HMAC-SHA256 hash of it is stored. If
you have lost a key's value, rotate it. `keyPrefix` and `keySuffix` are the only fragments
kept, and neither is enough to reconstruct the key.

Session-authenticated only — an API key cannot be used to manage API keys.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The ID of the API key to fetch.

404.description: No key with this ID belongs to the caller.

delete.description:
Permanently removes an API key and its record. Use `POST /api-keys/{id}/revoke` instead if
you want to keep the audit trail.

`data` is `null` on success.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The ID of the API key to delete.

404.description: No key with this ID belongs to the caller.

get.description:
Retrieves the authenticated user's master profile along with an account summary. Requires the
`resume:read` scope when called with an API key.

When the user has never saved a profile, this still returns `200` with a placeholder whose
`id` is an empty string and whose `content` is `{}` — it does not return `404`. Cached for
1 hour and invalidated on write.

put.description:
Replaces the authenticated user's master profile. Requires the `resume:write` scope when
called with an API key.

**This is a full replacement, not a patch.** `profile` is validated strictly: every property
of `MasterProfileContent` must be present, and any key not in the schema is rejected. Send
empty arrays for sections you have no data for. Read the profile first, modify the object you
got back, and send the whole thing.

Pass the `updatedAt` you last read as `expectedUpdatedAt` for optimistic concurrency; omit it
only when creating the profile for the first time. The example below is a complete minimal
payload that validates.

profile.summary: Backend engineer focused on distributed systems.

example.message: Master profile was updated from another session. Refresh and retry.
Master profile payload is too large

get.description:
Returns the caller's current GitHub and LinkedIn import quota status in one call.

- **GitHub import** is a real GitHub OAuth-backed integration (up to 30 of the account's most
  recently updated repositories, deterministically mapped to skills by repository language —
  no AI is involved). Free users get 1 import/day and may only import their own OAuth-connected
  GitHub account. Paid users (any active AI Credits or Portfolio Pro/Bundle plan) may import
  any public GitHub username, but are still capped at a hidden 50 imports/day — this protects
  the single shared `config.github.token` request budget used by every paid import and the
  GitHub sync cron job from being exhausted by one account.
- **LinkedIn import** is not a LinkedIn API integration — it's an AI parse of raw text the
  user pastes in (copied profile text, or text extracted from an exported PDF). Free users get
  1 import/month; paid users get unlimited imports.

Both import types share a single `replaceMaster` request flag and always create a brand-new
RESUME document from the imported data, in addition to optionally overwriting the master
profile.

post.description:
Imports a GitHub profile and repositories directly via the GitHub REST API (no AI parsing) and
creates a new RESUME document from the result. Free users can only import their own
OAuth-connected GitHub account (`usernameOrUrl` is ignored in that case); paid users may import
any public username, subject to the hidden 50/day shared-token cap described on
`GET /profiles/import/quota`.

400.description: Free user has no connected GitHub account, or a validation error

example.message: Please connect your GitHub account in settings to import your profile.
GitHub profile for "octocat" not found or API call failed.

value.message: Free users can only import from GitHub once a day. Upgrade to Creator Pro for unlimited imports.
You've reached the daily limit of 50 GitHub imports. This protects the shared GitHub API budget used by all users. Please try again tomorrow.

post.description:
Parses raw copy-pasted LinkedIn profile text (or text extracted from an exported PDF) using AI
and creates a new RESUME document from the result. This is an AI-parsed paste, not a LinkedIn
API integration. Free users get 1 import/month; paid users (AI Credits or Portfolio Pro/Bundle)
get unlimited imports.

example.profileText:
Jane Doe
Software Engineer at Acme Corp
...

400.description: Validation error

details.message: LinkedIn profile text must be at least 10 characters long

example.message: Free users can only import from LinkedIn once a month. Upgrade to Creator Pro for unlimited imports.
Failed to parse profile data using AI. Please try again.

get.description:
Lists the authenticated user's documents (resumes, cover letters, portfolios, link-in-bio
pages), optionally filtered by type. Soft-deleted documents are excluded.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Filter documents by type.

post.description:
Creates a new document. If no `content` is provided for a RESUME or COVER_LETTER, it is
auto-seeded from the user's MasterProfile (when one exists). Free-tier users are limited to
1 active document per type; upgrading removes that limit.

example.message: Free users can only have 1 active resume at a time. Upgrade to Creator Pro for unlimited documents.
Document content payload is too large

patch.description:
Updates a document using optimistic concurrency control: `revision` must match the
document's current revision or the request fails with `409`.

value.message: Document slug is already in use

example.message: Document content payload is too large

delete.description:
Soft-deletes a document by setting `deletedAt`. The document is immediately excluded from
list/get responses. Hard delete and restore exist at the service layer but are not exposed
through any public route.

`data` is `null` on success — the deleted document is not echoed back.

get.description:
Returns the caller's current ATS scan quota status. This endpoint works for anonymous
callers too (quota is keyed by a hashed IP when unauthenticated).

There is a single shared scan-quota bucket for both the deterministic `/ats/check` scan and
the AI-powered `/ats/analyze` deep analysis — they are **not** two separate quotas. Limits:

- Anonymous: 1 scan / 48 hours
- Free logged-in: 2 scans / 24 hours
- Subscriber (active AI Credits or Bundle plan): 300 scans / billing period

post.description:
Extracts plain text from an uploaded resume file (PDF, DOCX, TXT, Markdown, or JSON, max 5MB)
for use as the `resume` field on `/ats/check` or `/ats/analyze`. Does not consume ATS scan
quota — only the check/analyze endpoints do.

400.description: Missing file, or unsupported/unreadable file

value.message: Upload a PDF, DOCX, TXT, Markdown, or JSON resume.

example.message: Resume extraction took too long to process.

post.description:
Runs the free, rule-based ATS readiness scan — no AI call is made. Works for anonymous
callers. Consumes one unit from the shared ATS scan quota (see `GET /ats/quota`).

example.jobDescription: We are looking for a Software Engineer with React experience...

post.description:
Runs the deterministic scan plus an AI deep-analysis pass on top of it (explanation, missing
evidence, keyword opportunities, prioritized fixes). Requires authentication. Consumes one
unit from the same shared ATS scan quota as `/ats/check` — this is not a second, separate
quota. Requires the `ai:write` API key scope when called with an API key.

Optionally fetches a job description from a URL instead of requiring pasted text
(`fetchJobUrl: true` + `jobUrl`). The fetch is SSRF-hardened: HTTPS-only on the standard port,
rejects localhost/private/link-local addresses, resolves DNS once and pins that IP for the
whole request (including redirects), and caps redirects to 3, response size to 2MB, and the
request timeout to 8 seconds.

example.jobDescription: We are looking for a Software Engineer with React experience...

400.description: Validation error, or job URL fetch was blocked

blockedUrl.summary: Job URL resolves to a blocked network

value.message: Job URL resolves to a blocked network.

403.description: API key is missing the ai:write scope

example.message: This API key does not have permission for this action.
AI ATS analysis could not be completed.

post.summary: Convert Resume Text To Structured JSON
post.description:
Uses AI to convert raw resume text into structured JSON Resume-shaped fields. Requires an
active AI Credits or Bundle entitlement, and spends credits independently of the shared ATS
scan quota above. Requires the `ai:write` API key scope when called with an API key.

403.description: Missing entitlement, or API key is missing the ai:write scope

example.message: Resume conversion requires an active AI Credits or Bundle plan.
AI resume conversion could not be completed.

get.description:
Lists every available AI generation action along with its Standard and Expert mode credit
costs. Use this to build pricing UI before calling `/ai/generate`.

Costs only — no user data is returned, and no credits are spent. This endpoint carries no
scope requirement, but it is not open to the public: the request must carry an API key or
originate from a whitelisted first-party origin, or it is rejected with `401`.

The response always contains an entry for all seven action keys. **Treat this endpoint as the
only source of truth for pricing** — the actual credit values come from server-side
configuration and can change without a documentation update, so read them at runtime rather
than hardcoding the illustrative numbers shown here.

503.description: The AI policy is missing or invalid on the server.

post.description:
Runs an AI generation action (rewriting a section, generating a cover letter, tailoring a
resume to a job description, etc). Requires the `ai:write` scope when called with an API key.

Credits are handled with a two-phase reserve → commit/release flow: the cost for the chosen
action + mode is reserved from the caller's AI credit wallet before the AI provider is called,
then committed only after a successful response. If the AI call fails or errors out, the
reservation is released instead of committed — a failed generation never burns credits.

Expert mode uses a stronger, more expensive model than Standard mode for the same action.

input.context: 5 years of experience building React applications.
input.jobDescription: We are looking for a Senior Frontend Engineer...

400.description: Validation error, or text/context exceeds the action's character limit

example.message: Provide text, context, or a job description for this AI action.

403.description: API key is missing the ai:write scope

example.message: This API key does not have permission for this action.

409.description: requestId was already used, or is still processing

example.message: This AI request id can no longer be reused.
The AI provider could not complete the request.

get.description:
Lists the subdomains of every portfolio currently in `LIVE` or `GRACE` status, most recently
updated first. Returns subdomain and timestamp only — no portfolio content.

No user session is required, but the request must carry an API key or originate from a
whitelisted first-party origin; otherwise it is rejected with `401`. Cached for 5 minutes.

Returns the published snapshot for a live portfolio subdomain.

Returns `404` for a suspended portfolio, or one whose grace period has just expired — that
lookup also flips the record to `SUSPENDED` as a side effect. Cached for up to 10 minutes,
shortened to the remaining grace window for portfolios in `GRACE`.

No user session is required, but the request must carry an API key or originate from a
whitelisted first-party origin; otherwise it is rejected with `401`.

400.description: The subdomain is empty or reserved once normalised.

404.description: No live portfolio exists at this subdomain.

post.description:
Records an analytics view for a published portfolio. Responds `202 Accepted` with
`data: null` — the count is not persisted synchronously.

Views are buffered in Redis, deduplicated per viewer IP for 30 minutes, and flushed to
Postgres by a scheduled job. A repeat view inside that window is accepted and silently
dropped, so a `202` does not guarantee the count increased.

No user session is required, but the request must carry an API key or originate from a
whitelisted first-party origin; otherwise it is rejected with `401`.

referrer.description:
Full referring URL. Only its hostname is stored, lowercased and truncated to 255
characters; an unparseable value is recorded as an empty host.

404.description: No live portfolio exists at this subdomain.

get.description:
Returns the caller's current portfolio draft document (if any), publication status, and
billing summary in one call. Session-authenticated only — this route does not accept an API
key.

put.description:
Creates or updates the caller's single PORTFOLIO document with a new content snapshot.
Uses optimistic concurrency via `revision` once a draft already exists. Session-authenticated
only.

The response is a trimmed projection of the document, not a full `Document` record.

404.description: Portfolio draft not found (when documentId was provided but doesn't belong to the caller)

409.description: Draft was changed in another session, or the subdomain conflicts with an existing document slug

example.message: Portfolio draft changed in another session.

get.description:
Returns the caller's own portfolio draft for rendering a preview, without publishing it.
The response is a trimmed projection of the document, not a full `Document` record — it has
no `slug`. Session-authenticated only.

post.description:
Publishes the given draft revision to its chosen subdomain, making it publicly reachable.
Premium templates (`nimbus`, `cipher`) require an active Creator Pro subscription.

**Current-state caveat:** in production, publishing is gated behind a hardcoded
`ADMIN_EMAIL` check independent of plan tier (`isAdminUser`) — regular users can save drafts,
preview, and manage everything except actually flipping a portfolio live. This is a
temporary rollout restriction, not a permanent product limitation. Only administrators can
exercise this endpoint end-to-end in production today; it is unrestricted in development.

400.description: Validation error, incomplete portfolio content, or an unusable image reference

incompleteContent.summary: Draft does not satisfy the stricter publish schema

value.message: Complete the required portfolio details before publishing.

badAsset.summary: Referenced image is missing, not owned, or not READY

value.message: Portfolio contains an unavailable or invalid image.

403.description: Production publishing restriction, or premium template requires a subscription

value.message: Publishing is disabled in production during this phase.
Publishing the premium template "nimbus" requires an active Creator Pro subscription.

409.description: Stale revision, or subdomain already in use

example.message: Save the latest draft before publishing.

post.description:
Takes a published portfolio offline — status becomes `SUSPENDED` with reason
`user_unpublished`, and the underlying document reverts to `PRIVATE` visibility. The document
itself is not deleted, so the portfolio can be republished later.

Idempotent: if the caller has never published, the call still succeeds and returns
`data: null`. Session-authenticated only.

get.description: Views for the last 30 days plus top referrer hosts. Returns all-zero data if the caller has never published.

post.description:
Issues a presigned Cloudflare R2 PUT URL (10-minute expiry) for a JPG, PNG, or WebP image up
to 5MB. Upload the file directly to `uploadUrl` with a matching Content-Type/Content-Length,
then call `POST /portfolio-assets/complete` to verify and activate it. Session-authenticated
only.

400.description: Unsupported image type, or size out of range

example.message: Upload a JPG, PNG, or WebP image.

503.description: Media uploads are not configured (R2 credentials missing)

post.description:
Verifies an uploaded asset with a server-side HEAD request against R2 (confirming size,
content type, and optional checksum match what was declared) and marks it `READY` so it can
be referenced from a portfolio. Session-authenticated only.

400.description: Uploaded file does not match the declared size/type/checksum

503.description: Media delivery is not configured (public base URL missing)

delete.description:
Deletes the R2 object and its metadata row. `data` is `null` on success.
Session-authenticated only.

This does not rewrite any portfolio that still references the asset — remove the reference
and save the draft first, or publishing will fail with `400`.

get.description:
Returns the caller's plan, subscription status, entitlements, AI credit wallet, and public
catalog in one call. Entitlements (e.g. portfolio publishing) and the AI credit wallet are
two independent systems — a plan can grant one, both, or neither depending on `productKey`.
Session-authenticated only.
Lists the caller's processed billing webhook events (most recent 50). Session-authenticated only.
Returns the caller's current AI credit balance, reserved amount, and next expiring grant. Session-authenticated only.
Lists recent AI credit reservations/commits/releases for the caller's wallet. Session-authenticated only.

post.description:
Creates a hosted Dodo Payments checkout session for a subscription product. `productKey` and
`interval` are validated against a fixed whitelist (the product catalog) before being handed
off to Dodo — arbitrary product/interval combinations are rejected with `400`. A Redis lock
prevents starting a second checkout while one is already in flight. Session-authenticated
only; blocked for non-admins in production during the current rollout phase.

400.description: Invalid product/interval combination

example.message: That billing interval is not available for this product.

403.description: Payments disabled in production for non-admins

example.message: Payments are disabled in production during this phase. Only administrators can perform payments.

409.description: A checkout is already active, or the caller already has an active subscription

503.description: The selected billing product is not configured

post.description: Releases the Redis lock created by `POST /billing/checkout`, allowing a new checkout to be started. Session-authenticated only.
Creates a Dodo Payments customer portal URL for managing an existing subscription. Session-authenticated only; blocked for non-admins in production during the current rollout phase.

403.description: Payments disabled in production for non-admins

post.description:
Creates a one-time Dodo Payments checkout session for an extra AI credit pack, on top of any
subscription. Session-authenticated only; blocked for non-admins in production during the
current rollout phase.

403.description: Payments disabled in production for non-admins

503.description: Extra credit checkout is not configured

post.description:
Creates (or replaces, if one already exists for this document) a public share link for a
document. Optionally password-protected — passwords are scrypt-hashed and never returned in
any response — and optionally set to expire.

The caller **must have claimed a username first**, since it forms the public URL
(`/{username}/{slug}`); without one the request fails with `400`. Requires the
`resume:write` scope when called with an API key.

400.description: Validation error, or the caller has not claimed a username yet.

details.message: String must contain at least 1 character(s)

get.description: Given a comma-separated list of document IDs, returns which of them currently have an active (non-expired) share link. Useful for badging a document list in the UI.

parameters.name: ids
parameters.description: Comma-separated document IDs.

get.description: Returns the (at most one) share link for a document, offset-paginated for shape consistency with other list endpoints.

delete.description:
Deletes the share link, immediately breaking its public URL. `data` is `null` on success.
Requires the `resume:write` scope when called with an API key.

get.description:
Returns the shared document's title and snapshot, unless the link is password-protected — in
which case only `passwordRequired: true` is returned and the caller must call
`POST /shares/public/{username}/{slug}/verify` with the password.

No user session is required, but the request is still gated: it must carry an API key, or
originate from a whitelisted first-party origin. A bare request from an unrecognised origin
is rejected with `401`.

200.description: Shared document fetched successfully (or password required)

post.description:
Verifies a password-protected share link's password using a timing-safe comparison against
the stored scrypt hash, and returns the full snapshot on success.

No user session is required, but the request must carry an API key or originate from a
whitelisted first-party origin, same as the read endpoint.

**Rate limited to 3 attempts per 5 minutes per IP** — considerably tighter than the rest of
the API, to make these links impractical to brute-force.

429.description: Too many password attempts — 3 per 5 minutes per IP.

example.message: Too many requests. Please try again later.

post.description:
Public, unauthenticated endpoint. Records a click against an affiliate's referral code.
Entire affiliate program is gated behind a feature flag (`config.growth.affiliateProgramEnabled`)
that defaults off in production until explicitly enabled — every route in this group,
including this one, returns `503` while the flag is off.

get.description: Public, unauthenticated endpoint. Top 50 affiliates ranked by commission earnings, for the current calendar month or all-time.
Returns the caller's affiliate status, tier, wallet, clicks, referrals, commissions, and withdrawal history. Session-authenticated only.

post.description: Enrolls the caller in the affiliate program, generating a unique referral code. Idempotent — calling this again while already enrolled just returns the current dashboard. Session-authenticated only.
Attaches another affiliate's referral code to the caller's account. Self-referrals are rejected, and each account may only apply one referral code, ever. Session-authenticated only.

400.description: Validation error, or attempted self-referral

409.description: This account already has a referral

post.description:
Requests a payout of available affiliate commission balance (minimum $25 / 2,500 cents).
Payouts are reviewed and marked paid manually by an admin out-of-band (bank transfer, PayPal,
etc) — Dodo Payments only exposes a read-only settlements API, not an outbound transfer API,
so this cannot be automated end-to-end yet. Session-authenticated only.

400.description: Available balance is too low

409.description: An active withdrawal request already exists

get.description:
Returns the caller's current ambassador application status. This is intentionally a small
surface today — application intake and status are the only things live. There is no
points/rewards/redemption API yet; that system has not been built.

Gated behind a feature flag (`config.growth.ambassadorProgramEnabled`) that defaults off in
production until explicitly enabled — every route in this group returns `503` while the flag
is off. Session-authenticated only.

post.description:
Submits (or resubmits, once previously rejected) a campus ambassador application. Rejects a
duplicate application from a user who already has one pending review, and rejects existing
ambassadors from re-applying. `graduationYear` is validated as a real 4-digit year on both the
client and the server. Session-authenticated only.

example.whyJoin: I want to help students discover VeriWorkly and build better resumes.
example.superpower: I can explain anything in under a minute.
example.funFact: I've organized three hackathons on campus.

400.description: Already an ambassador, application already pending, or validation error

value.message: You are already a campus ambassador.
Your ambassador application is already pending review.

ApiKeyAuth.name: X-API-Key
ApiKeyAuth.description:
Your personal API key — `vw_` followed by 64 hex characters. The same key is also accepted
as `Authorization: Bearer vw_...`.

LocalSession.name: veriworkly-auth.session_token
LocalSession.description: Internal session cookie for local development.

OffsetPaginationMeta.description:
Offset-pagination metadata returned alongside `items` by every paginated list endpoint.
Requests may use either `page`/`pageSize` or `limit`/`offset`; the response always echoes both
views of the same window.

total.description: Total number of matching records, ignoring the current window.

page.description: 1-based page index for the current window.

nextCursor.description: Always null — these endpoints are offset-paginated, never cursor-paginated.

HealthLivenessData.description:
Liveness payload. `GET /api/v1/health` deliberately touches no external dependency, so uptime
checks do not wake database compute — it reports only that the Node.js process is responding.

HealthReadyData.description: Readiness payload. Only `GET /api/v1/health/ready` verifies PostgreSQL and Redis connectivity.

username.description:
Null until the user claims one. Immutable once set, and required before any share link can
be created.

_count.description: Relational counts for the user's own records.

resumes.description:
Counts every Document the user owns — every `type`, and soft-deleted ones included.
It is not a count of RESUME-type documents. Use `GET /documents` for an accurate,
filterable list.

normalizedUsername.description: The value that would actually be stored, after server-side normalisation.

id.description: Empty string when the user has never saved a master profile yet.

shareResumeCount.description: Number of ShareLink records owned by the user.

MasterProfileBasics.description: All properties are required when writing — this object is validated strictly.

email.description: Must be a valid email address. An empty string is rejected.

phone.description:
Must contain exactly 10 digits once non-digit characters are ignored, so `"9876543210"` and
`"(987) 654-3210"` both pass. The value is stored as sent — it is not reformatted — and an
empty string is rejected.

MasterProfileContent.description:
The resume-shaped JSON stored in `MasterProfile.content`.

**On `PUT /profiles/master` this object is validated strictly and every property listed below
is required.** Send an empty array for sections you have no data for — omitting a key fails
with `400`, and so does sending any key not listed here. Every array item carries a
client-generated `id`. Field limits (string lengths, 200 items per array, 10-digit phone
numbers, `YYYY-MM` / `YYYY` date formats) are enforced server-side.

expectedUpdatedAt.description: Pass the `updatedAt` value from your last read. Omit only when creating the profile for the first time.

connectedUsername.description: The GitHub login connected via OAuth, when known (GitHub quota only).

usernameOrUrl.description:
A GitHub username or profile URL. Free users may only import their own OAuth-connected
account (this value is ignored server-side and the caller's authenticated GitHub login is
used instead); paid users may import any public username.

replaceMaster.description: When true, also overwrites the user's master profile with the imported content.

profileText.description: Raw copy-pasted text from a LinkedIn profile export or PDF (parsed by AI, not fetched via any LinkedIn API).

replaceMaster.description: When true, also overwrites the user's master profile with the imported content.

data.description: The newly created resume Document seeded from the imported data.

ChangelogPrRef.description: A pull request referenced by a changelog entry, resolved from the GitHub release body.

version.description: Semantic version string, unique across entries.

latest.description: The most recently published entry, or `null` when the changelog is empty.

contributorCount.description: Distinct pull-request authors across every entry.

completionRate.description: Percentage of `total` that is done, formatted to 2 decimal places. `"0.00"` when there is nothing synced.

data.description: Null until the first GitHub sync has run for the configured repository.

NullDataResponse.description: Success envelope for endpoints that acknowledge an action without returning a body.

ApiKeyScope.description:
API key scopes are a fixed set — requesting any other value fails with `400`. Each scope maps
to the `requireApiKeyScopes(...)` gate on the corresponding routes. Scope checks apply only to
API-key callers; session callers are not scope-gated.

ApiKeyListItem.description:
The trimmed shape returned by `GET /api-keys`. The secret is **not** included in any form —
not even masked. Use `keyPrefix` to identify a key in a list.

keyPrefix.description: First 8 characters of the key (`vw_` plus 5 hex characters).

lastUsed.description: Written at most once every 5 minutes per key, so it lags real usage slightly.

ApiKeySecret.description:
Returned only by `POST /api-keys` and `POST /api-keys/{id}/rotate`. `key` is the full secret
and is shown exactly once — it is stored only as an HMAC-SHA256 hash and cannot be retrieved
again.

key.description: The full secret — `vw_` followed by 64 hex characters. Shown once, never again.

rateLimit.description: Requests allowed per 15-minute window for this key.

expiresAt.description: Always set. Defaults to 365 days from creation when not supplied.

rotatedFromId.description: Only present on a rotate response — the id of the key this one replaced.

ApiKeyDetail.description:
The full metadata record for a single key, returned by `GET /api-keys/{id}`. Identical to
`ApiKeySecret` minus `key` — the secret itself is unrecoverable after creation.

keySuffix.description: Last 8 characters of the key. Not enough to reconstruct the secret.

rateLimit.description: Requests allowed per 15-minute window for this key.

lastUsed.description: Written at most once every 5 minutes per key, so it lags real usage slightly.

slug.description: Unique per user. Also used as the portfolio subdomain slug for PORTFOLIO documents.

content.description: Document-type-specific JSON payload (resume schema, portfolio schema, etc).

revision.description: Incremented on every update. Required (and checked) on PATCH for optimistic concurrency control.

deletedAt.description: Set by soft delete. Documents with a non-null deletedAt are excluded from list/get.

id.description: Optional client-generated id. If a document with this id already exists for the caller, it is returned as-is (idempotent create).

content.description: If omitted for RESUME/COVER_LETTER, content is auto-seeded from the user's MasterProfile when one exists.

updateShareSlug.description: When true and an active share link exists, its slug is updated to track the new document slug.

revision.description: Must match the document's current revision. Mismatch returns 409.

category.description: One of: parse, contact, structure, content, format.

AtsReport.description:
Deterministic, rule-based ATS report. Computed entirely server-side without calling any AI
provider. Shape depends on the caller's auth state: anonymous requests to `/ats/check` get
`AtsRestrictedReport` (score + verdict only); any authenticated user (free or subscriber)
gets `AtsFullReport`. `/ats/analyze` requires auth and always returns `AtsFullReport`.

AtsFullReport.description: Full deterministic report — every rule's evidence, all matched/missing keywords, all prioritized fixes. Requires an authenticated caller.

checksPassed.description: Number of deterministic rules the resume passed.

checksTotal.description: Total number of deterministic rules evaluated.

wordCount.description: Words counted in the extracted resume text.

AtsCategoryScore.description:
Per-area rollup of the deterministic rules. Returned to authenticated and anonymous callers
alike: it is an aggregate of per-rule impacts, so it says which part of the resume is losing
points without revealing which rule fired or what that rule weighs.

score.description: Percentage of this category's own weight the resume kept (0-100).

passed.description: Rules in this category that passed.

possible.description: Worst-case points this category could have cost.

AtsRestrictedReport.description:
Returned instead of AtsFullReport when /ats/check is called anonymously — scores, a verdict,
and the per-area rollup, but no rule evidence, no keyword lists, and only the single
highest-impact fix.

matchedKeywordCount.description: How many job-description terms the resume covers. The terms themselves require auth.

missingKeywordCount.description: How many job-description terms the resume is missing. The terms themselves require auth.

AtsAiInsights.description: Null when the AI step was skipped (e.g. `/check`, which never calls AI).

limit.description: 1 for anonymous callers per 48h window, 2 for free logged-in users per 24h window, 300 for subscribers per billing period.

canConvertResume.description: True only for active AI Credits / Bundle subscribers — gates access to /ats/convert-resume.

extract.description: Separate budget for resume file uploads (POST /ats/extract) — does not share the scan quota above.

text.description: Plain text extracted from the uploaded PDF, DOCX, TXT, Markdown, or JSON resume file (max ~50,000 characters).

resume.description: Resume text, or a JSON Resume-shaped object. Either is accepted.

jobDescription.description: Optional plain-text job description to compute a jobMatchScore against.

jobUrl.description: Required when fetchJobUrl is true. Fetched server-side through an SSRF-hardened HTTPS-only fetcher (blocks localhost/private/link-local IPs, pins the resolved IP for the whole request, caps redirects to 3, response size to 2MB, and timeout to 8s).

requestId.description: Client-generated idempotency key for the underlying AI credit reservation.

data.description:
AI insights are drawn from the same shared ATS scan-quota bucket consumed by `/ats/check` —
there is only one ATS quota, not separate "scan" and "AI" allowances.

resume.description: Raw resume text to convert into structured JSON Resume fields.

AtsConvertedResume.description: AI-extracted resume fields. Every field defaults to an empty string/array when not explicitly present in the source text — nothing is invented.

creditsSpent.description: Requires an active AI Credits or Bundle entitlement — this endpoint spends credits independently of the shared ATS scan quota above.

data.description:
Map of AI action key to its credit cost per mode, containing an entry for every action in
`AiActionKey`. The values below are illustrative only — real costs come from server-side
configuration, so read them from this endpoint rather than hardcoding them.

mode.description: Expert mode uses a stronger model at a higher credit cost.

input.description:
Required, though every field inside it is optional and defaults to an empty string. At
least one of `text`, `context`, or `jobDescription` must be non-empty or the request fails
with `400`. Per-action character limits apply — see `GET /ai/actions`.

jobDescription.description: Silently truncated to the action's own job-description limit rather than rejected.

requestId.description: Client-generated idempotency key. Credits are reserved against this id before generation and only committed on success — a failed or errored generation releases the reservation instead of spending credits.

documentId.description: Optional document to associate the credit transaction with.

balance.description: AI credit wallet balance after this generation.

snapshot.description: Published portfolio content snapshot (validated against the portfolio content schema at publish time).

isPremium.description: Whether the owner currently has an active portfolio_pro/bundle subscription.

PortfolioPublicationRecord.description:
The stored publication row as the owner sees it. This is a different shape from the public read
endpoint: it exposes the owner-only bookkeeping columns and has no `isPremium`.

suspensionReason.description: One of `grace_expired` or `user_unpublished` when the portfolio is suspended.

publicUrl.description:
`https://{subdomain}.veriworkly.com` in production, or
`http://{subdomain}.localhost:3004` in development. Added by the publish endpoint
only — it is not a stored column.

data.description:
The updated publication record with `status: SUSPENDED`, or null when the caller had never
published a portfolio. No `publicUrl` is included.

PortfolioDraft.description:
A trimmed projection of the caller's PORTFOLIO-type Document — not a full `Document`. Only the
fields below are selected.

slug.description: Kept in sync with the portfolio subdomain.

revision.description: Send this back as `revision` when saving or publishing.

draft.description: Null when the caller has never saved a portfolio draft.

billing.description: Same shape as the Billing "/billing/me" response.

documentId.description: Omit to create (or continue) the user's single PORTFOLIO document.

revision.description: Required once a draft already exists, for optimistic concurrency (409 on mismatch).

snapshot.description: Portfolio content. The draft schema is more permissive than the publish schema (empty strings allowed) so incomplete drafts can still be saved.

revision.description: Must match the draft's current revision (save the latest draft first).

sizeBytes.description: Must be greater than 0 and no more than 5 MB.

uploadUrl.description: Presigned Cloudflare R2 PUT URL. Upload the file directly to this URL with a matching Content-Type/Content-Length.

checksum.description: Optional ETag to verify against the uploaded object.

url.description:
Public CDN URL. Only returned after a server-side HEAD request against R2 confirms the
uploaded object's size, content type, and (optionally) checksum match what was declared
when the upload URL was requested.

canPublish.description: Portfolio-publish entitlement is a separate system from the AI credit wallet below.

catalog.description: Public product/pricing catalog (prices, intervals, entitlements per plan).

reserved.description: Credits currently held by in-flight AI generations that have not yet committed or been released.

productKey.description: Validated against a fixed product/interval whitelist before being handed off to the Dodo Payments checkout API.

redirectUrl.description: Relative path (must start with a single `/`) to return to after checkout.

url.description: Dodo Payments hosted checkout URL to redirect the user to.

redirectUrl.description: Relative path (must start with a single `/`) to return to after checkout.

url.description: Dodo Payments hosted checkout URL for the one-time credit pack purchase.

token.description: Same value as `slug` — the public path segment for this link.

publicPath.description:
Convenience path built from the owner's username and the link slug. Only returned by
`POST /shares`, not by the list endpoint.

snapshot.description: The static content snapshot captured when the link was created.

hasPassword.description: The scrypt password hash itself is never returned in any API response.

snapshot.description: Static content snapshot captured at share time.

password.description: When provided, the link is scrypt-hashed and requires this password to view.

updateSlug.description: Regenerate the public slug instead of reusing the existing one (if a link already exists for this document).

snapshot.description: Only present once no password is required, or after successful verification.

referrals.description: Most recent 50 referrals (recency-limited preview). Use totalReferrals/conversions for exact counts.

code.description: Another affiliate's code. Self-referrals are rejected.

data.description: The created AffiliateWithdrawal record (status starts as REQUESTED).

graduationYear.description: A real 4-digit year, validated both client- and server-side.

AmbassadorStatus.description:
Intentionally small today: this surface only covers application intake and status. There is
no points/rewards/redemption API yet — that system has not been built.

role.description: The user's account role (e.g. USER, AMBASSADOR).

ValidationError.description: Bad Request - The request body or parameters are invalid.

UnauthorizedError.description: Unauthorized - Authentication failed or session expired.

BadRequestError.description: Bad Request - The request parameters or body are invalid.

NotFoundError.description: Not Found - The requested resource does not exist.

FeatureDisabledError.description:
Service Unavailable - This feature is gated behind a feature flag that is currently off
(`config.growth.affiliateProgramEnabled` / `config.growth.ambassadorProgramEnabled`), which is
the default in production until the program is explicitly enabled.
